verdict.rationale: The documented flow covers the whole story. The developer creates an applicant and a workflow run server-side, which returns an SDK token, collects captures via the SDK, and reads results through webhooks or polling. Entrust also hosts the verification journey through Smart Capture Link, which redirects users into the workflow. Facial Similarity reports compare the selfie against the captured document, so this is a complete document-plus-selfie verification without custom capture UI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation of a web drop-in/embed SDK (only mobile SDKs are named).

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a complete document-plus-selfie verification with a hosted or drop-in flow — create a session server-side, redirect or embed, and read the result — without building capture UI myself

citations.quote: create an applicant → create a workflow run (returns an SDK token) → collect captures via SDK → retrieve results via webhook or polling
Entrust hosts the verification journey on your behalf... The Smart Capture Link is then sent to your customers, redirecting them towards the interactive steps of a workflow.
Now you're ready to create an applicant from your backend server, using a valid API token.

Facial Similarity reports compare the most recent live photo, live video or motion capture provided by an applicant during an identity verification flow to the face on their most recently captured identity document
asynchronously monitor the status of identity verification workflows by configuring webhook events to notify you of changes in workflow status
